headline: Norway Central Bank Keeps Policy Rate Unchanged at 4.5 Percent
summary: Norway's central bank kept its benchmark policy rate unchanged at 4.5 percent, stating it remains prepared to raise borrowing costs if necessary.
why: Central bank interest rate decisions directly influence domestic borrowing costs, commercial bank lending rates, and foreign exchange valuations.

impacts.name: Norway
impacts.why: Maintaining the policy rate anchors short-term domestic interest rates.
